In this archive, you will hear [[person|john-todd|John Todd]] most often in [[show|the-lone-ranger|The Lone Ranger]], [[show|challenge-of-the-yukon|Challenge of the Yukon]], and [[show|the-green-hornet|The Green Hornet]].
plain_text:
John Todd appears in 1981 recordings across 3 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1937 to 1956. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear John Todd most often in The Lone Ranger, Challenge of the Yukon, and The Green Hornet.

Characters credited here include Tonto.
